protocol.reuse_note: 2026-27 was already used for the first confirmatory read of FG1/FG1C; this is a second read of the same window and is not a fresh holdout.
protocol.odds: ESPN core-API historical odds (DK / ESPN BET) are an auxiliary comparator only, not execution prices or CLV evidence.

gaps.player_availability: No legitimate point-in-time public injury/availability source is shipped with this challenger. The production gate already blocks a missing injuries role. Documented as a gap; not filled with a leaky proxy.
gaps.returning_minutes: Player box scores exist on the box for some seasons, but there is no dated preseason roster or transfer snapshot that would let returning minutes be computed without using current-season appearances (leakage). Early-season ratings continue to use the previous-season carry prior only.
gaps.travel_proxy: Travel miles use city/state labels from sportsdataverse schedules and region centroids (same-city 0, same-state 120, else haversine of centroids). Not surveyed road distance.
